skill.name: mcp-builder
skill.description: Guide for building MCP servers that expose external services through clear, reliable tools. It covers planning, TypeScript and Python implementation patterns, testing, and evaluation workflows.
skill.summary: Build MCP servers in TypeScript or Python with design, testing, and evaluation guidance.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, TypeScript template literals, placeholder URLs, and placeholder API keys in reference material. I confirmed the evaluation harness risk where user-supplied environment variables are forwarded to a locally launched MCP server, and added a semantic finding for unrestricted local command execution during stdio evaluation.

remediation.issue: Evaluation harness can launch arbitrary local commands.
remediation.suggestion: Document that scripts/evaluation.py should only evaluate trusted server commands, or add an allowlist for expected runtimes.

remediation.issue: Environment variables can be forwarded to evaluated MCP servers.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to pass only scoped test tokens and avoid production secrets when using the -e option.

remediation.issue: Reference documentation uses realistic placeholder secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Label placeholders clearly and avoid realistic token prefixes such as ghp_xxx in examples.

content.value_statement: Developers need clear patterns for MCP servers that expose useful tools without confusing agents. This skill provides planning, implementation, testing, and evaluation guidance for Python and TypeScript MCP projects.
actual_capabilities: Guides API research and tool selection for MCP server design.
Explains TypeScript and Python project setup patterns.
Covers schemas, output formats, annotations, pagination, and error handling.
Includes an evaluation workflow and Python harness for MCP server tests.
Points to protocol, SDK, and local reference documents for implementation details.
limitations: Does not generate a complete server without project-specific API details.
Reference examples may need updates as MCP SDKs change.
Evaluation scripts require local dependencies and an Anthropic API key.
Users must review generated server code for authentication and data safety.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Integration
use_cases.description: Map a service API into useful MCP tools, resources, and transport choices before coding.

use_cases.title: Standardize Server Design
use_cases.description: Apply consistent naming, schemas, pagination, and error handling across a team of MCP servers.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Agent Usability
use_cases.description: Create read-only evaluation questions that test whether agents can complete realistic tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic MCP Server
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new service integration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to plan an MCP server for this service: [service name]. Identify core tools, required authentication, transport choice, and first implementation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Tool Schemas
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate schema design for selected operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to design MCP tool names, input schemas, output formats, and annotations for these API operations: [operations]. Prioritize clear agent usage.

prompt_templates.title: Review an MCP Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to review this MCP server design or code summary: [details]. Check naming, validation, pagination, error messages, transport, and security concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Create Evaluation Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation for an existing MCP server.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to create an evaluation plan for this MCP server: [tool list and data domain]. Produce ten stable, read-only questions with verification strategy.

output_examples.input: Plan an MCP server for a ticketing API.
output: Recommended tools cover ticket search, ticket details, comments, assignment, and status updates.
Use read-only annotations for search and detail tools, and destructive annotations for mutation tools.
Start with stdio for local testing, then move to streamable HTTP for remote deployment.

output_examples.input: Review my current MCP tool list for usability.
output_examples.output: The review highlights unclear names, missing pagination, broad response payloads, and error messages that need recovery guidance.

output_examples.input: Create evaluation coverage for a GitHub MCP server.
output: The plan uses stable read-only questions about issues, pull requests, repositories, labels, and dates.
Each question includes one expected answer and a verification path based on tool calls.

best_practices: Read current MCP protocol and SDK documentation before choosing server patterns.
Keep tool names action oriented, service specific, and easy for agents to discover.
Build evaluations with read-only, stable questions and verified expected answers.
anti_patterns: Do not expose broad low-level endpoints without practical workflow coverage.
Do not return large unfiltered payloads when pagination or filters are available.
Do not pass production secrets to untrusted MCP servers during evaluation.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you design, implement, test, and evaluate MCP servers for external services.

faq.question: Does it support Python and TypeScript?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Python FastMCP and the TypeScript MCP SDK.

faq.question: Can it choose the best tools for my API?
faq.answer: It can guide tool selection, but you must provide API details and product requirements.

faq.question: Does it include evaluation support?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains evaluation design and includes a Python harness for MCP server testing.

faq.question: Does it automatically secure generated servers?
faq.answer: No. You must review authentication, authorization, logging, and data handling before deployment.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
